_faq.q: What does the Valentine's package include?
_faq.a: A night in a Comfort room with rose petals and a surprise in your room, a tasting menu at Restaurant Asteria with a glass of prosecco with dinner, an extensive breakfast buffet the next morning and access to the wellness area on the Top Floor. Parking is free.
You can arrive from 1 to 28 February 2027, for one night. In 2027 Valentine's Day falls on Sunday 14 February. Pick your date in the booking module and you will see right away what is available.
With the tasting menu you put together five dishes yourself: three small starters, a main course and a dessert. With dinner you both get a glass of prosecco. The restaurant serves dinner until 21.30.

_faq.q: What is in the wellness area and when is it open?
_faq.a: The wellness area on the Top Floor covers more than 300 m², with four saunas (infrared, forest, salt stone and walnut wood), a steam cabin, experience showers, a plunge and herbal bath, foot baths and a relaxation room. Open Monday to Thursday from 16.00 to 22.00 and Friday to Sunday from 12.00 to 22.00. Tuesday is swimwear day; on the other days the wellness area is swimwear-free.

_faq.q: Can we stay in a different room?
_faq.a: The package is based on a Comfort room. Would you prefer a Deluxe room with its own infrared sauna? Ask about the options when you book, or call reception.

_faq.q: Can I cancel free of charge?
_faq.a: You will see the cancellation terms of the package when you book, before you confirm your reservation. Not sure? Give reception a call.
